_note: Non-client sender rules. Abhijeet, 2026-08-10: 'a lot of the crude records you can tell yourself... those are promotional letters and things like that. You should be able to sort them out yourself.' Anything matched here is auto-excluded and NEVER reaches the mapping queue. Structural rules come first because they generalise; the named lists only catch what structure misses.
_precedence: learned-mappings.json > registry client domains > structural > categories > ask
_bulk_subdomains_note: A first label used purely to send bulk mail. 'mailers.hdfcbank.bank.in', 'digital.axisbankmail.bank.in', 'custcomm.icici.bank.in', 'marketing.goindigo.in', 'updates.easemytrip.com', 'em1.cloudflare.com', 'info.clickup.com' are all this shape. A real client writes from their bare domain. Added 2026-08-14 from the 58 rows sitting in `held`: 'mail.' (mail.clickup.com, mail.vapi.ai, mail.chatarv.ai), 't.' (t.shopifyemail.com, t.upwork.com), 'm.' (m.parallels.com), 'send.' (send.zapier.com), 'members.' (members.netflix.com), 'learn.' (m.learn.coursera.org). A client's own domain still wins: the registry check runs BEFORE this one.
_plus_tags_note: The tag half of a plus-addressed sender ('nick+news@leftclick.ai'). The sender chose that tag to say what the mail IS, which makes it the most honest structural signal on the message — and it generalises to every marketer who uses the convention, which no domain list does.
_noreply_locals_note: Existing convention already records these as noise:sender:<local>. Kept so this classifier agrees with what is already in the table rather than inventing a second vocabulary.

investment._note: Abhijeet named hdfcfund.com and axismf.com explicitly as bank/AMC promotional mail. Extended 2026-08-14 with the exchange/depository/registrar senders found in `held` — IPO allotment advices, annual reports and corporate-action mail. Statutory rather than promotional, but equally not a client.

saas_vendor._note: Tools Etherwise USES. Not clients, and not promotional either — a distinct reason so spend/vendor analysis can find them later.

personal_interest._note: Abhijeet: 'chessbase is the chess, like, you know, player'. Personal hobby mail, not business.
